beats.spoken_anchor: push back on it, ask follow-up questions, do inversion
beats.viewer_inference: Three concrete things to do with an AI answer, so the advice is understood at a glance.
beats.state_before: A confident AI ANSWER card with a gold check mark.
beats.state_after: Three stacked moves (1 PUSH BACK, 2 FOLLOW UP, 3 INVERT); the check has become a red '?' and the card is turned upside down.
beats.causal_action: Each move arrives on its spoken word: on 'push back' the check turns into a question, 'follow-up' adds the second move, on 'inversion' the answer card is flipped over.
beats.speaker_return: Back to the conversation at 18.765 s for 'be like, oh, but what about this?'.

beats.spoken_anchor: always hold a healthy level of skepticism
beats.viewer_inference: The takeaway is balance: neither trust everything nor doubt everything.
beats.state_before: A skepticism meter with its needle at TRUST ALL.
beats.state_after: The needle rests on the gold HEALTHY zone.
beats.causal_action: On 'always hold' the needle swings past TRUST ALL toward DOUBT ALL, then settles on HEALTHY as he says 'healthy level of skepticism'.
beats.speaker_return: Back on the speaker at 35.0 s for 'no matter what information you're taking in' to close on his face.
